purpose: Application-ready, provenance-preserving research evidence consumed by DTF cultivation tools and atlases.
rules: Raw provider payloads are never a Tools runtime API.
Every dataset and record preserves stable source identity and retrieval provenance.
Provider display names are not identity anchors when accessions or persistent identifiers exist.
Numeric observations require explicit units; rounded or unknown source values remain null rather than becoming false precision.
Research evidence is reference context and must not be mixed with private cultivation records.
Consumers must ignore unknown additive fields and reject unsupported schema major versions.
